window: the mean of 3 days of day and night passes
encoding: red: 0 where no pass saw the cell in 3 days, else round(ppb / 1.4) + 1 (ppb = (red - 1) x 1.4); green: 1 seen, 2 filled from the cells around
source: NASA GIBS: AIRS on Aqua, carbon monoxide at 500 hPa, day and night passes (AIRS_L2_Carbon_Monoxide_500hPa_Volume_Mixing_Ratio_Day, AIRS_L2_Carbon_Monoxide_500hPa_Volume_Mixing_Ratio_Night)
made: the page's own reading (web/src/earth2/layers/co/grid.ts), done once by the engine (engine/past_days.py)

credits.GIBS: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS). Real Earth: VIIRS on NOAA-20, Suomi NPP and NOAA-21, corrected reflectance, true colour, with NASA's Blue Marble where none saw anything; smoke from space: VIIRS Deep Blue on NOAA-20, Suomi NPP and NOAA-21, aerosol optical depth, the last 3 days; carbon monoxide: AIRS on Aqua, 500 hPa, the last 6 days (Earth 2: the mean of 3 days of day and night passes); the live picture (Earth 2): Himawari AHI over Asia and the Pacific, GOES-East and GOES-West ABI over the Americas, the red visible band, 1 km, every 10 minutes.
